mapper.select: SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'receipts',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.rcpt_id) FROM tb_bl_rcpt r JOIN tb_bl_bill b ON b.bill_id=r.bill_id WHERE r.cncl_yn='N' AND b.cncl_yn='N' AND to_char(r.rcpt_dt,'YYYY-MM')=#{month}),'[]'::jsonb), 'bills',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('bill_id',b.bill_id,'bill_ym',b.bill_ym, 'pay_due_dt',b.pay_due_dt,'unpaid',GREATEST(0,b.tot_amt-COALESCE((SELECT sum(r.rcpt_amt) FROM tb_bl_rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=b.bill_id AND r.cncl_yn='N'),0))) ORDER BY b.bill_id) FROM tb_bl_bill b WHERE b.cncl_yn='N' AND to_char(b.pay_due_dt,'YYYY-MM')=#{month}),'[]'::jsonb) )::text
